description: Encode text as Base64, Base64url, Base32, Base58 or hex, as URL percent-encoding or as HTML entities, or decode such a string. Decoding answers decoded_text when the bytes are UTF-8 text and decoded_base64 when they are binary. Base58 uses the Bitcoin alphabet, base64url the URL-safe alphabet without padding, url RFC 3986 percent-encoding with a space as %20. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

data.description: Text to encode, or the encoded string to decode.

name: encode_data
title: Encode or decode Base64, Base32, Base58, hex, URL or HTML
